subject: Decision gates canvas + MAP starter — Lumen pilot
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Jordan <ajordan@lumen.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Decision gates canvas + MAP starter — Lumen pilot

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the call yesterday — it was great to sync on success criteria for the pilot. Per our conversation, I attached a lightweight Decision Gates Canvas and a starter MAP (Google Doc + slides) that outline:

- Key milestones (POC sign-off, perf validation, security review, acceptance)
- Owner matrix (decision owners + SMEs)
- Suggested 50-day close timeline with pacing (week-by-week gates)
- Minimal gating criteria for moving from one stage to the next

Two asks to move forward:
1) Can you confirm the technical and procurement stakeholders who need to be on the MAP? I filled in the people we discussed but would rather you validate.
2) Can you confirm whether SOC 2 evidence and a SSO/SCIM runbook are required for the pilot sign-off? If procurement needs a formal package we can pull the latest artifacts.

I've left comments in the doc for the first three gates (POC, perf, security). Proposed immediate next steps:
- You review the doc and update owners by EOD Monday
- We lock the pilot window and schedule a 30-minute kickoff once owners are confirmed

Attachments: initial_map_canvas.gdoc, 50day_close_slides.gslides (links inside the doc)

Cheers,

Tessa Morgan
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
T: +1 (415) 555-0172
https://redwood.com/

From: Alex Jordan <ajordan@lumen.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@lumen.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 13:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Decision gates canvas + MAP starter — Lumen pilot

Tessa,

Thanks — I pulled the doc and skimmed. High level looks good. A couple notes from my side:

- Procurement is going to want an asset list and the SOC 2 attestation. I looped them on this thread.
- Security will need SCIM/SSO setup details; our infra lead (cc'd on a follow-up I've just added) will want the runbook.
- One ask: can we tighten the perf gate to include a 95th percentile latency target for 2k concurrent requests? Otherwise we'll have to extend validation.

I'll confirm stakeholders by Monday and share a contact for the infra lead. If you can drop the SOC2 cert and a one-page SSO checklist in the doc that speeds procurement.

Thanks,
Alex Jordan
Director of Data Products — Lumen AI
ajordan@lumen.ai

Alex / procurement team,

- A perf validation section with the 95th percentile latency target for 2k concurrency (Ben added load specs)
- A procurement appendix with a link to the SOC 2 summary and the SSO checklist (summary attached inline in the doc)
